questions.question: Paul wrote that for people in Christ Jesus, the law of the Spirit of life did what?

answers.text: Set them free from the law of sin and death
Made them strong enough to obey every rule
Gave them a list of new rules to keep

questions.question: Paul wrote that the law was powerless to save people. How did God do what the law could not?

answers.text: He sent His own Son as an offering for sin
He gave His people a stricter law to follow
He sent His prophets with one more warning

questions.question: Paul told believers in Rome they did not receive a spirit of slavery. What did they receive instead?

answers.text: The Spirit of adoption to sonship
A spirit of service under the law
A spirit of courage for the battle

questions.question: Paul told believers in Rome that God, who raised Jesus from the dead, will also give life to their mortal bodies through His Spirit. True or false?
